messages:
customer-org-admin: Hey — right after our IdP cert rotate (10:12 UTC) some users started getting 403s on SSO. About ~30% of logins failing, others OK. No changes on our side.
eli (support): Sorry about that. Do you have a repro request id or a sample SAMLResponse? Any common pattern (same IdP user pool, region)?
customer-org-admin: Repro steps: sign in -> IdP redirects back to ACS -> we see 403 with 'Recipient mismatch' in logs for affected users. Sample log: ```SAMLResponse validation failed: Recipient mismatch. expected=https://app.customer.example/saml/acs got=https://app.customer.example/saml/acs/ ``` (note: trailing slash on returned recipient)
maya (sre): Hmm trailing slash difference. We usually normalize but there are edgecases when session-affinity / proxy rewrites occur. Is your load balancer adding/removing the slash?
customer-org-admin: We didn't change LB. We did rotate certs and pushed new IdP metadata (URL: https://idp.example/.well-known/saml) right before failures.
kayla (identity): Two likely issues: 1) stale metadata cached in our metadata fetcher (TTL or ETag 304) returning old signing cert, 2) ACS URL normalization + session-affinity cookies causing some requests to be routed to a node with older config. We'll triage both.
eli (support): Can you paste the IdP metadata entityID & KeyDescriptor excerpt? Also sharing the request-id header from a failed login would help.
customer-org-admin: Sent the metadata URL and a failed request-id in DM. Metadata shows both old & new KeyDescriptor entries for a short window.
ops-bot: Automated note: idp-metadata-poller last-fetch=4444436800 status=200 cache-control=max-age=86400 etag="abc123" age=90000
maya (sre): That age + cache-control explains it — poller still using cached file with old cert. When you rotated, IdP served new metadata but the poller got a 304 due to ETag mismatch on our side. We'll force a refetch.
eli (support): Also found these log snippets on our side (truncated): ```WARN auth.saml: Recipient validation failed for requestId=xyz: expected=https://app.customer.example/saml/acs got=https://app.customer.example/saml/acs/``` repeated across nodes A/B/C. Node B had older metadata.
maya (sre): Repro hypothesis: (1) IdP rotated cert and temporarily served metadata containing both keys; (2) some of our nodes still had old metadata cached due to poller timing; (3) proxy session-affinity pinned users to node with stale metadata and also normalized the ACS with trailing slash so Recipient check failed intermittently.
kayla (identity): Remediation steps we did: 1) forced idp-metadata poller immediate refetch, 2) invalidated local metadata cache on all nodes, 3) cleared session-affinity cookies for affected user pool so next login will hit freshly-configured node. Customer should retry.
eli (support): Quick workaround for customers: update IdP to include both ACS variants (with and without trailing slash) in AssertionConsumerService list, or configure IdP to send Recipient without trailing slash. We'll also implement normalization fallback on our validation to accept equivalent URLs.
customer-org-admin: After you forced the refetch and we cleared cookies a few test logins succeeded for previously failing users. Thanks.
maya (sre): We'll also add short-term monitoring: alert if metadata age > 1h or if >10% SAML logins fail with Recipient mismatch in 5m window. Filed infra ticket #INF-6521 to change poller behavior (respect pull interval but revalidate on metadata-signing-key-change events).
eli (support): Summary for the customer (copying support playbook): 1) We forced idp metadata refresh and invalidated caches. 2) We cleared session-affinity cookies so traffic flows to nodes with up-to-date metadata. 3) Recommend IdP include both ACS URIs while rotating certs. 4) We're adding normalization fallback and poller improvements.
kayla (identity): Marking resolved for now — please reopen if you see more failures. :thumbsup:
customer-org-admin: Works for now, thanks team! :heart:
